messages.subject: LCS for cross-sectional design
parts:
Hi everyone, 

I'm analysing cross-sectional data and I'm trying to fit a LCS. 
I first wanted to make sure that it was theoretically possible. 
Secondly, what would you advise me to do in order to improve the fit? 

Concretely: I have participants in first year of a training process (Y1) and participants in the third year of the training process (Y3). In Y1 there are 3 groups: "conservatory", "demos", "school" In Y3 there are also these 3 groups: "conservatory", "demos", "school"   I am assessing the scores of these 6 groups at one test. In my dataframe, I have: One column named "participant_id" with one row per participant One column named "Y1" with the scores of the participants of Y1 and NAs for all other participants (i.e. Y3 participants) On column named "Y3" with the scores of the participants of Y3 and NAs for all other participants (i.e. Y1 participants) One column named "group" with the name of the group to which each participant belongs (3 levels : "conservatory", "demos", "school"). There are these three levels for participants of Y1 and those of Y3 One column named "mean_score" with the score associated to each participant One column named "age_years" with the age of each subject in years One column named "ses_index" with the socieconomic status index (SES) of each subject One column named "iq_score_norm" with the IQ score of each subject I would like to use a Latent Change Score model to model the change (DCOG) between scores of participants of Y1 and scores of participants of Y3, contrasting groups and controlling for age, SES and IQ Here is the model I have written: ULCSh1 = ' # SET UP PARAMETERS Y3 ~ 1*Y1 DCOG =~ 1*Y3 Y3 ~ 0*1 Y3 ~~ 0*Y3 Y1 ~ c(mean_conse, mean_demos, mean_schoo)*1 Y1 ~~ c(var_conse, var_demos, var_schoo)*Y1 Y1 ~ age_years+ses_index+iq_score_norm DCOG ~ c(DCOG_conse, DCOG_demos, DCOG_schoo)*1 DCOG ~~ DCOG DCOG ~ c(beta_conse, beta_demos, beta_schoo)*Y1 # CONTRASTS contrast_consedemos := DCOG_conse - DCOG_demos contrast_conseschoo := DCOG_conse - DCOG_schoo contrast_demosschoo := DCOG_demos - DCOG_schoo
'  

Thank you very much for your help!
